reader.reads: Every place in German, each thesis and link against its grounds; five places on the scan, word by word and mark by mark.

sigmund-freud.das-unheimliche:double-as-.note: The place says «Man muß sich damit begnügen, die hervorstechendsten unter jenen unheimlich wirkenden Motiven herauszuheben» and names «das Doppelgängertum». The thesis is borne out, but the cut also includes three intervening sentences about the novel being too complex to summarize, the reader’s confusion and the effect on understanding; those sentences do not say this thing. Separate, linked cuts can retain the antecedent and the sentences that name the motif without treating the intervening discussion as part of the formula.

summary: The theses and links are supported by their places, and the checked pages agree with the packet. The cut for the double motif contains intervening sentences that do not say the thesis and needs a narrower formula.
